student_learning_goal: I can use direction words to move.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use direction words to move.
header.character_watermark: Bot the Robot Programmer in the top-right with arrow buttons. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line from each direction word to its matching arrow.
parts.visual_layout: Four direction words on the left and four arrow icons on the right for matching.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten matching layout for coding worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: FORWARD, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT. Right column: 4 arrow icons (up, down, left, right).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_MATCH at Part 1: keywords name the direction arrows match task.

parts.student_instructions: Bot follows: forward, forward, right, forward. Colour Bot's path on the mat.
parts.visual_layout: A 4x4 grid mat with Bot at start corner and a coloured path leading to the apple.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten path-colouring layout for coding worksheet, B&W line art. 4x4 grid with Bot at A1 and apple at B3. Empty cells for colouring path.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_PATH at Part 2: keywords name the path grid colouring task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw an arrow showing Bot how to go to the apple.
parts.visual_layout: A simple grid with Bot at start and an apple two squares away with a workspace for drawing.

image_placeholders.description: A Kindergarten arrow-draw workspace for coding worksheet, B&W line art. 3x3 grid with Bot at A1 and apple at C1. Empty area for child's arrows.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_DRAW at Part 3: keywords name the arrow draw workspace.

parts.answer_key: Arrow forward, forward (or right, right depending on layout).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw a code with 5 steps.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Diagnostic — check direction word matching.
